topology_note: Many PFI systems use a shared fused supply and ECU low-side switching, but relay arrangement and driver topology vary by vehicle and injector type. High-side and peak-and-hold systems must be represented separately where applicable.
safety_notes: Do not treat fuse rating or clamp voltage as universal.
Do not probe ECU outputs without approved procedures and wiring information.
Use service information for the exact vehicle.

typical_values.termination: two 120-ohm terminators in conventional high-speed CAN; about 60 ohms across CAN-H/L when powered down

notes: Typical references only; network topology, termination and CAN variant require vehicle documentation.
safety_notes: Measure resistance only with power removed and network appropriately isolated.
Do not assume every vehicle bus exposes two accessible 120-ohm terminators.
